reppo.wrongIf: The 34% weekly jump gives back within 7 days, or no project news appears by end of December.

aergo-2.wrongIf: Trading drops back to normal within a week with no announcement.

aurora-near.upside: Long-running NEAR-linked chain with a Revolut listing and new CEO at some point this year (date not confirmed); nothing dated ahead.
aurora-near.cheap: No reason found it is overlooked; the 36% one-day jump has no news I could find.
aurora-near.wrongIf: Price falls back under $0.03 within 7 days.
aurora-near.vsScanner: Scanner treats the spike and score jump as news; I find no story, and my 11-09 case was flat (-5%).

sodax.upside: The ICON network shuts down on 2026-12-31, which is the last day to swap ICX into SODA; the final swap push could bring attention.
sodax.cheap: Hardly anyone tracks the new ticker after the migration; but holders forced to migrate may also sell.
sodax.wrongIf: The 80% weekly jump reverses by mid-December, or the final migration date slips.
sodax.vsScanner: ATH numbers mix in old ICX history (scanner's January 2026 high vs CoinMarketCap's $0.026 SODA-only high), so the 30x to ATH is wrong; real distance is about 8x.

soil.upside: Licensed private-credit lending protocol that expanded to the XRP Ledger in February 2026; no dated token event.
soil.cheap: Almost no trading ($47K a day for a $10M coin), so few buyers can even find it.
soil.wrongIf: Daily trading stays under $50K through December.
soil.vsScanner: Agree with the scanner's low-trading flag; that alone rules out more than caution.

nextplace.wrongIf: Price falls below its first-picked level.
